output.answer: Accenture's annual revenue for its most recently completed fiscal year — fiscal 2026, ended August 31, 2026 — was $74.2 billion (exactly $74,183,445 thousand), an increase of 6% in U.S. dollars (5% in local currency) over fiscal 2025 revenues of $69.7 billion ($69,672,977 thousand). The results were reported October 1, 2026 in the company's fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 earnings release and its Form 10-K. Note that Accenture's fiscal year ends August 31, so its 'annual' figures do not align with the calendar year.
caveats: Accenture's fiscal year ends August 31, so its 'annual' revenue (fiscal 2026: $74.2 billion) covers September 2025–August 2026 and differs from calendar-2025 revenue.

The 6% growth rate was affected by foreign exchange (5% growth in local currency), and fiscal 2026 GAAP figures reflect the completion of a business optimization program ($308 million of costs in fiscal 2026), so 'adjusted' metrics differ slightly from GAAP.
Fiscal 2027 is already underway; the figure will change again when Q1 FY2027 results are reported (December 2026).

key_facts.fact: Accenture reported revenues of $74.2 billion for fiscal 2026 (year ended August 31, 2026), an increase of 6% in U.S. dollars and 5% in local currency.
Exact GAAP revenues per the fiscal 2026 Form 10-K consolidated income statement: $74,183,445 thousand in fiscal 2026 vs. $69,672,977 thousand in fiscal 2025 (and $64,896,464 thousand in fiscal 2024).
